units.source_text: 源氏来到明石小女公子那里，但见侍女与女童等正在院中山上移植小松，以祝长寿。

en.t: Genji went to the young Akashi princess, and saw the gentlewomen and little girls transplanting young pines on the garden hill to celebrate long life.

units.source_text: 这些年轻人都兴高采烈，热衷地东奔西走，样子煞是好看。

en.t: All these young people were cheerful and excited, eagerly running here and there, and they made a very charming sight.

units.source_text: 住在冬殿里的明石姬特地备办些须笼和桧木制的食品盒，内装种种物品，送与源氏太政大臣。

en.t: Lady Akashi, who lived in the winter residence, had specially prepared some su baskets and cypress-wood food boxes, filled them with various things, and sent them to Genji, the Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 又在一枝形状美好的五叶松上添附一只人工制造的黄莺，并系着一封信，一并送来。

en.t: She also attached an artificial bush warbler to a beautifully shaped branch of five-needle pine, tied a letter to it, and sent it along as well.
In the letter, there was a poem that said:
